trigger.description: A rule mutation commits its source-of-truth row, audit record, and durable index job, but the real post-commit index publisher cannot complete that job.
setup_commands: # Replace the active index directory with a symlink so the real publisher claims the durable job and then refuses publication.
trigger.invocation: ee rule add --workspace . 'A durable rule whose derived index publication is blocked.' --json

message_contains: automatic publication of durable search-index work
Search may omit the current rule state
